messages:
maria: Quick sync — Optimize toolkit delivery: quantization recommendations, batching/caching suggestions, and regression alerts. Goal: ship core docs + config templates by end of sprint. Who's on what?

alex: I'll take quant recs. Working off model-v2 and small Llama variants. PR draft by Tue, final by Thu. Need final perf tables from CI (latency/cost). @ravi can you confirm the CI benchmark keys?

ravi: Yep, I'll run additional perf sweep Wed morning. Do we want 4-bit/8-bit/FP16 comparisons? Also need list of representative prompts.

alex: 4-bit (q4) and int8 + FP16 for baseline. Prompts: short-chat, long-context summarization, reranking set. I'll upload prompt set to the repo: /optimize/prompt-sets.

jordan: I'll own batching/caching templates + docs. Plan to add k/v cache examples and batch sizing heuristics. Ping me for perf numbers to tune defaults.

maria: Ownership note: Alex = quant recs + recommendations doc; Jordan = batching/caching + config templates; Ravi = perf runs + regression harness; I'll own rollout and release notes.

sara-bot: regression-alert: nightly eval failed on model-v2 at 03:14 UTC — BLEU drop detected on summarization test. Details: https://internal.eval/reports/1770

ravi: Noted, I'll triage the regression with the perf run. Might be quantization-related — will compare q4 vs fp16.

jordan: Re batching: for low-latency routes default batch_size=8 for T4-like hardware, batch_timeout=20ms. For high-throughput routes use batch_size=64, batch_timeout=60ms. Will add as templates.

alex: One open question: do we want to recommend per-model quant profiles or single global profile? My initial thought: per-model to preserve quality.

maria: per-model sounds right. Also list of dependencies: need eng-infra to expose the 'batch_timeout' knob in dedicated config (cc @ravi — will coordinate with infra).

ravi: I can coordinate with infra. I'll file infra ticket today — INF-4382.

jordan: For docs, I'll include a short CLI snippet for generating quant profiles: ```bash
quant-tool profile --model model-v2 --calib-file samples.json --out profiles/model-v2-q4.json
```

alex: FYI the quant-tool outputs a 'calibration score' in the header; I'll document thresholds.

maria: Code reviews: alex's PR will need @jordan + @ravi review for config changes. Jordan's batching PR should include perf regression guard. Let's set required reviewers.

jordan: Can someone ping @jordan when PRs are up? I'll try to review within 24h.

alex: Will post PR link here when ready.

maria: Blockers? Any infra limits or capacity issues?

ravi: Potential capacity for running wide perf sweeps — need a small dedicated slot. Requesting 2 GPU-hours Wed morning.

maria: I'll submit the capacity request and mark as priority for this sprint.

deploy-bot: new dedicated-queue slot created: job-5531

jordan: Tiny doc nit: include example of cache warmup commands: `curl -X POST /warmup -d @prompts.json`

maria: Thanks. Wrap-up: owners noted, action items: Alex PR (quant), Jordan PR (batching/templates), Ravi perf runs + infra ticket, Maria release notes + capacity request. We'll re-sync async — please update PR/issue links here. :thumbsup:
